title: No foreign transaction fees explained
summary: Explains that card purchases and withdrawals in a non-USD currency incur a 0% foreign transaction fee (foreign currency transactions only). Covers foreign-currency card purchases, online foreign-currency charges, and international ATM withdrawals, and clarifies exclusions like ATM operator surcharges/network fees and that stop payments cost $25.
faqs: Do you charge a foreign transaction fee for purchases in a non-USD currency?
Are international ATM withdrawals subject to a foreign transaction fee?
Does the foreign transaction fee apply to online transactions charged in a foreign currency?
What fees are NOT included in the foreign transaction fee policy (e.g., ATM operator surcharges or network fees)?
Are check-related services included under foreign transaction fees (e.g., stop payment)? If not, what is the stop payment fee?
If a merchant offers to charge in USD instead of local currency, is that part of the foreign transaction fee?
keywords: card purchases processed in a foreign currency
online transactions charged in a foreign currency
merchant charges in USD (instead of local currency)
